title: Test Suite Failure Detection Inaccuracy in Jest Test Output
body:
**Bug Description**
when running a Jest test and test suite failures are present in the output displayed on the screen, Claude still thinks all tests passed.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: iTerm.app
- Version: 0.2.14
- Feedback ID: faba7b60-d47d-43b1-b553-de6ec007272a
author: cfdude
